threads.body: [General] This treats every removed line as irrelevant, so a PR that only deletes an entry from `## Unreleased` gets `changes_unreleased=False` and is classified again from its runtime changes. That can reintroduce a release note the contributor deliberately removed. Please detect deletions against the parent version's Unreleased bounds as well (and add a deletion-only regression case).
threads.hunk:
@@ -261,6 +262,56 @@ def count_deprecated_deltas(commit_hash: str) -> tuple[int, int]:
     return added_count, removed_count
 
 
+def patch_adds_lines_in_range(patch: str, start_line: int, end_line: int) -> bool:
+    new_line: int | None = None
+    for line in patch.splitlines():
+        hunk = re.match(r"^@@ -\d+(?:,\d+)? \+(\d+)(?:,\d+)? @@", line)
+        if hunk is not None:
+            new_line = int(hunk.group(1))
+            continue
+        if new_line is None:
+            continue
+        if line.startswith("+") and not line.startswith("+++"):
+            if start_line <= new_line < end_line:
+                return True
+            new_line += 1
+        elif line.startswith("-") and not line.startswith("---"):
+            continue
